note: Four byte-identical copies live in each repo's scripts/tests/fixtures/. CI checks out one repo at a time, so a test must never read a sibling repo's path.

allowed_deviations.board_tabs: aut: dashboard, tools, skills, tokens, usage, sources (6; sources replaces the per-agent/plugin/MCP detail views)
allowed_deviations.no_credits_ocut: OpenCode reports no credit value; cbut stores model_responses.credit, qcut stores model_calls.credits
allowed_deviations.qoder_token_availability: QODERCN_EXPOSE_TOKEN_USAGE=1 on the CLI enables real tokens; BYOK routes report tokens with no credits; row_reports_tokens renders a route-level zero as a dash
allowed_deviations.usage_total_formulas: cbut/ocut/qcut each own their expression; cross_repo_golden.json pins each repo's own answer
allowed_deviations.null_semantics: absent field is NULL, never a fabricated 0; a reported 0 stays 0
allowed_deviations.timer_frequency: cbut/ocut 15m, qcut daily, aut none; qcut keeps daily (decided 2026-11-09)
allowed_deviations.headless_extras: ocut modes; qcut commands/env; cbut sessions; aut board commands
allowed_deviations.schema_names: cbut model_responses; ocut/qcut model_calls with differing columns
allowed_deviations.one_token_total: Usage Total only; no second unnamed total (API Total removed)
